appearance_facts.fact: One blue line with black circular markers descends monotonically from the top-left (2005) to the bottom-right (2015); the 2005 marker is the highest point and the 2015 marker is the lowest.
Each marker carries a temperature label above it; the 2005 label (24.0°C) sits at the upper-left and the 2015 label (10.0°C) at the lower-right, with all intermediate labels between them.
The line spans the full horizontal width of the plot area; the leftmost marker aligns with the 2005 tick and the rightmost with the 2015 tick.

printed_facts.fact: Review scope: District Heat Demand change, 2005-2015; Routing criterion: Whether the full-period district heat demand change requires substantial-change follow-up

public_definitions: Determine whether the full-period (2005-2015) district heat demand change should enter substantial-change follow-up or remain in routine monitoring.
Option A: Route the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change to substantial-change follow-up.
Option B: Keep the 2005 to 2015 district heat demand change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation.
Option C: Route the district heat demand record to archive and background filing.
uncertain: No explicit numerical threshold or percentage rule for 'substantial-change' is printed on the dashboard or form; the decision must rest on the magnitude of the visible full-period drop.
The 2011 x-axis tick label is absent (gap between 2010 and 2012), so the 2011 data point/label is not shown.
